company.name: Circle
company.description:
Circle 
Circle is a highly efficient delivery service with a diverse selection of products delivered to your doorstep in just 15 minutes! Select from over 6,000+ items available in its extensive catalog, from fresh produce, snacks, and ready-made meals, to beverages, household essentials, personal and baby care items, and even pet food. You can also enjoy an array of special offers and discounts with our in-app promotions and coupons.

Circle is there for your late-night cravings, for a last minute grocery while you plan to unleash your inner home-chef on a weekend, for a quick cold brew coffee to get you through your mornings!

With Circle, you can order from your app and get your items delivered to your location within minutes.

Why Circle?

With Circle, we bring your groceries to your doorstep in just minutes, whether it's day or night, and at prices comparable to your local grocery store, with a free delivery, making the whole process even better.

You can choose from over 4,000 products across a wide range of products from popular brands you would find in your regular supermarket, ensuring that you're fully covered.

The categories of products we deliver:

► Fruits & Vegetables

► Bakery

► Dairy & Eggs

► Meat & Fish

► Deli

► Beverages

► Ice Cream

► Breakfast

► Frozen

► Sweets & Snacks

► Vegan & Vegetarian

► Baby Products

► Toiletries

► Household Items

► Pet essentials

Smooth experience

Say goodbye to substitutions, too, our inventory is updated in real-time, ensuring you receive precisely what you ordered without substitutions.

Circle's delivery service is also contact-free to help you stay safe.

No more waiting in long grocery lines because we value your time.

No more wasting time stocking your fridge, as your groceries will arrive in minutes.


We are faster!

With our large network of mini stores where our riders pack your order, we ensure a fast and efficient delivery. Although speed is our mission, safety is key, our delivery riders are trained to follow traffic rules and ensure prompt and secure delivery of groceries.

How to get the app

Simply download the Circle app, place an order, and enjoy lightning-fast delivery. Plus, Circle offers in-app promotions and coupons, making it an even more cost-effective option.

Enjoy a discount on your first delivery and join the Circle TurboMart community today.
